source_data_type: New independent synthetic video generation with global affine camera motion and same-color distractor occlusions
world_motion_definition: Direction relative to stationary textured world background; in camera_pan screen displacement includes camera translation
camera_registration_method: ORB video-only features plus RANSAC partial affine, no oracle camera transforms available in inference
study_question: On independent 2D synthetic videos with rotation, scale and same-color distractions, does ORB+RANSAC camera registration preserve background-relative target direction better than phase translation, and how often does gate override VLM wrongly?
privacy: Never commit generated MP4, models, training caches or private video to GitHub
new_test_protocol: 40 independent dev pairs, 100 never-inspected test pairs, 5 world-relative directions x 4 nuisances, forward/reverse paired
